scope: Static native review of furnishing concurrency, join/disconnect behavior, and live layout synchronization
conclusion: No recovered live furniture-layout synchronization path exists. HTTP is the durable layout authority; the native one-user check gates an attempt to enter edit mode but is not a continuous occupancy lock.

owner_editor_then_visitor_arrives.PlayerJoinedProcessor_0x5e4660: Builds the remote PlayerInfo/avatar in Memory and starts label/avatar loading. It does not call HousingManager, DeactivateUIMode, SaveAssetsAtServer, LoadAssetsFromServer, or the one-user popup.
owner_editor_then_visitor_arrives.OnAvatarLoaded_0x5e42d0: Enables the remote avatar and requests locomotion, companion, position and animation state. It performs no housing call.
owner_editor_then_visitor_arrives.DeactivateUIMode_0x6c3bc0: Disables housing UI/input when explicitly invoked, but neither player-join body invokes it.
owner_editor_then_visitor_arrives.Deactivate_0x6c3cd0: Disables housing UI/input/camera when explicitly invoked, but neither player-join body invokes it.
owner_editor_then_visitor_arrives.effect: A visitor arrival does not interrupt an owner who was already editing.

visitor_edit_attempt.HousingManager_Initialize_0x6c4080: At invocation time, requires the local player to be inside the authored collider and the remote-player dictionary count to be zero. A positive remote count starts ShowOnlyOneUserPopUpDelay instead of initializing edit UI.
visitor_edit_attempt.popup_MoveNext_0x6cb280: Only activates the popup, waits, then hides it. It does not deactivate an editor, save, reload, kick, or send TCP.
visitor_edit_attempt.effect: A visitor with the owner present cannot start editing. The point-in-time check does not stop an already active owner editor when a visitor arrives.

layout_visibility.initial_load: HousingManager.LoadAssetsFromServer 0x6c4520 sends N2HousingReadPreset; the visitor constructs the durable HTTP snapshot received during its own scene load.
layout_visibility.save: HousingManager.SaveAssetsAtServer 0x6c4dc0 serializes the local scene and sends the two HTTP save parts. HousingFurnishing.SaveAtServer also re-registers placed GenericInteractable children locally, changing the local generic-ID epoch.
layout_visibility.tcp_enum: The complete recovered TypeTCP enum 0..96 contains no furniture layout/add/remove/transform command. Genericinteractable type94 carries interaction state, not furniture placement/layout serialization.
layout_visibility.already_connected_visitor: No recovered producer tells an already connected visitor to reload the layout after the owner's HTTP save. Do not claim live furnishing refresh or matching regenerated generic IDs.

disconnect.owner: OnRemoteDisconnected 0x5e0c60 compares the disconnected GUID with HTTP read-preset field4 guidOwner and begins the kick decision unless the owner is in wardrobe.
disconnect.other_visitor: The ordinary remote is removed from Memory; no recovered housing reload or edit-mode transition is established.
disconnect.one_user_popup: The popup is an edit-attempt response. It is not a join notification and no recovered path uses it to terminate an editor on arrival.

safe_preservation_boundary: Furnish while alone for deterministic behavior.
A visitor joining during editing may see the last durable snapshot rather than unsaved or newly saved local changes.
After a save, require visitor scene reload/re-entry before claiming the updated layout is visible.
Do not authorize dynamic furniture GenericInteractable IDs across peers without an explicit shared mapping epoch.
Do not invent an editor-occupancy TCP signal or live furniture push; neither is present in the recovered client wire surface.
